Photos are planned by what the implementation reaches, never one fixed plan for every change: poles and wires → poles and junction
corners from near, mid and far, several angles, day and night; people → people with the clock running at crosswalks, kerbs, stops;
vehicles → vehicles at the junctions touched. Add a few general views to prove nothing else broke, and check performance and that
the code is our own (no roadcraft copy).

**Why:** the owner caught that pole photos were judged on the surface (missed corners without wires, two poles together, poles glued
to signal posts) and that mover fixes were closed with no mover photo at all.

**How to apply:** for every fix, before closing: list the pieces it changes, aim each shot at them, open every crop where they stand
and name each piece seen (which pole, which wire, which person); re-open earlier photos of a batch when a defect shows the judging was
shallow. Related: [[judge-photos-by-quality]], [[label-and-wait-photos]].
